notes: The furniture catalogue (Unit DE, Queue 16). Every item is named in GDD-10 §5's tier contents — F0 (floor mattress, single burner, crate table), F1 (bed, table + chairs, stove, wardrobe, fan), F2 (sofa, bookshelf, desk, better kitchen, curtains), F3 (dining set, TV, washing machine, study corner, decoration) — and 'tier' is the level the piece first appears in, so each tier's set is cumulative (F2 holds F1 + its own pieces). Prices live only in data/prices.json 'furniture' via price_ref (prices.json wins on disagreement). The individual prices are PROPOSED (Unit DE): no source prices pieces — GDD-10 §5 prices PACKAGES only (2x/4x/7x monthly rent) — so the pieces are priced to sum to the §5 Tier-3 package prices (F1 12,000; F2 additions 12,000, total 24,000; F3 additions 18,000, total 42,000). F0 pieces price 0: the F0 package costs 0 (scavenged/starter, GDD-10 §5). Package pricing still governs furnishing a tier; these piece prices exist so a single piece can be bought, sold back at the 50% second-hand rule (GDD-10 §5), or named by a losing event. No seeding yet — the seeding unit wires the purchase points.
